In a letter sent on Tuesday to the Smithsonian’s Board of Regents, Rep. Chellie Pingree, D-Maine, cited ProPublica’s recent story on the draft plans by a White House staffer targeting one of the Smithsonian’s most prominent museums, calling the reporting “extremely concerning.”

Rep. Chellie Pingree, the Democrat in line to oversee the Smithsonian Institution's federal funding, has vowed to investigate the Trump admin's efforts to reshape the museum — a day after photos surfaced purporting to show a plan to overhaul the institution and fire more than a dozen employees.

Rep. Chellie Pingree, D-Maine, who’s slated to lead the subcommittee that controls the Smithsonian’s funding, told ProPublica: “No White House employee riding on the Metro gets to design a plan for what future exhibits look like.”
